answer: A newcomer arrives as a sparrow on an island while the network measures its trust edges' conductance. A puppet farm betrays itself by topology: a thousand interlinked identities, barely touching the core, stay island-bound and earn nothing. The only exit is three bridge certificates from ravens, twenty-epoch veterans, graph-distant, one each per epoch; a raven whose sparrow proves fake is silenced ten epochs, so each certificate is bought singly above that risk. Smuggling 1,000 puppets takes 3,000 raven certificates; an honest sparrow crosses once, free, on introductions in hand.
